Though this work did present the largest reported ∆T at room temperature ECE and 100 MV/m compared to other literature using an IR camera, the results were not comparable with other literature using different measurement methods. The materials presented here have some additional advantages over other EC materials, including the potential to activate at a lower applied electric field, the ability to activate at lower temperatures, and/or a faster fabrication time. Overall, the EC performance of the thin films presented in this work encourages the potential of investigating electrospray techniques in this field for future manufacturing for commercial purposes.
